say:1:1030112701:1.text: I just got here not too long ago, so I may not know more than you do.
say:1:1030112701:1.source_cn: 我才刚刚到达这里，可能了解到的并不比你多。

say:2:1030112702:1.text: According to what I've read, the founding of Holistone is associated with a stone said to be imbued with divine power.
say:2:1030112702:1.source_cn: 文献上提及到圣石镇的建立曾与某块“石头”有关——据说那...

say:3:1030112703:1.text: There are other unconfirmed speculations, but I shouldn't spread them. Sorry, that's all I can share.
say:3:1030112703:1.source_cn: 其余无法确凿的猜测不应该被随意传播，抱歉我只能分享这么多。
